# Entelechae Visuals — Complete Developer & AI Knowledge Specification

> Entelechae Visuals (https://entele-visuals.vercel.app/) is a unified creative engineering and frontend resource discovery engine. Housing 29,627 verified web design assets across 3 primary catalogs: 897 interactive motion components, 28,047 full-site website templates, and 683 immersive website prompts & 3D scenes.

## Core Identity & Brand
- Name: Entelechae Visuals
- Parent Organization: Entelechae (https://entelechae.com)
- Production URL: https://entele-visuals.vercel.app/
- Primary Tech Stack: React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Framer Motion, Three.js, Lucide Icons
- License: MIT License for code components, Creative Commons for public references

---

## 1. Interactive Motion Components Catalog (897 Items)
Direct URL: https://entele-visuals.vercel.app/?mode=components

Categorized in exact taxonomic structure:
- Background Animations (295 assets) [/?category=background-animation]: Navier-Stokes fluid trails, particle networks, WebGL canvas shaders, digital matrix rain, generative noise fields, and aurora gradients.
- Interactive Elements & 3D Cards (132 assets) [/?category=interactive-elements]: 3D perspective tilt cards, physics-based hover cards, dynamic spring widgets, interactive HUD overlays, and futuristic counters.
- Kinetic Typography & Text Effects (91 assets) [/?category=text]: Smoky text dissolves, kinetic scroll reveals, multi-color gradient text, typewriter loops, and SVG text mask animations.
- Landing Page Sections (92 assets) [/?mode=sections]: High-impact animated hero sections, interactive bento grids, pricing comparison matrices, testimonial marquees, KPI tally boards, FAQ accordions, and animated footers.
- Motion Primitives & Transitions (102 assets) [/?category=animation]: Layout spring transitions, scroll-triggered fade/slide primitives, stagger lists, and magnetic interaction triggers.
- Image Galleries & Carousels (50 assets) [/?category=image-gallery]: 3D perspective card stacks, horizontal drag carousels, expandable photo grids, and parallax gallery viewers.
- Animated Buttons (29 assets) [/?category=button]: Shimmer border buttons, magnetic cursor pull buttons, liquid glow buttons, and neo-brutalist animated buttons.
- Modern Spinners & Loaders (28 assets) [/?category=loader]: Minimalist progress indicators, geometric morph loaders, and pulse glow rings.
- Custom Cursors (24 assets) [/?category=cursor]: Magnetic follower cursors, particle trail emitters, trailing glow circles, and spotlight cursors.
- Retro Canvas Games (20 assets) [/?category=retro-games]: Playable retro arcade games built with vanilla HTML5 Canvas including Asteroids, Snake, Pong, and Tetris.

## 2. Web Templates Directory (28,047 Verified Templates)
Direct URL: https://entele-visuals.vercel.app/?mode=templates

Curated multi-framework directory featuring live interactive iframe preview, performance audit metrics, and responsive device testing (Desktop, Tablet, Mobile):
- Framer (13,189 total / 7,886 free) [/?platform=framer]: Portfolio templates, SaaS landing pages, agency showcases, AI product marketing themes.
- Webflow (11,658 total / 193 free) [/?platform=webflow]: Agency websites, CMS blogs, portfolio themes, animated corporate sites.
- Shopify (1,486 total / 23 free) [/?platform=shopify]: Modern e-commerce storefronts, apparel boutiques, luxury product showcases.
- Next.js (812 total / 32 free) [/?platform=nextjs]: Full-stack React App Router templates, developer portfolios, SaaS platforms.
- React (522 total / 21 free) [/?platform=react]: Single-page applications, client dashboards, interactive landing pages.
- Astro (240 total / 15 free) [/?platform=astro]: Content-first portfolio templates, documentation themes with zero runtime JS.
- Nuxt & Vue (140 total / 20 free) [/?platform=nuxt]: Server-rendered Vue.js applications and creative design themes.

## 3. Immersive Website Prompts & 3D Spatial Scenes (683 Blueprints)
Direct URL: https://entele-visuals.vercel.app/?mode=immersive

Curated AI prompt blueprints optimized for frontier AI coding assistants (Claude 3.7 Sonnet, Cursor Composer, v0, GPT-4o):
- Full-Site Website Templates (59 prompts) [/?mode=immersive&category=template]: Comprehensive architectural design blueprints for complete interactive websites.
- 3D Spatial Scenes (114 prompts) [/?mode=immersive&category=3d_scene]: Three.js, React Three Fiber (R3F), and Spline 3D spatial scenes.
- Interactive Sections (10 prompts) [/?mode=immersive&category=section]: High-impact animated hero sections, dynamic bento grids, and feature blocks.
- Dynamic Backgrounds (476 prompts) [/?mode=immersive&category=background]: Fluid simulations, aurora waves, particle grids, and generative shaders.
- Shader Mesh Gradients (24 prompts) [/?mode=immersive&category=gradient]: Interactive CSS mesh gradients and WebGL canvas shaders with 26 color variations each.

Features:
- Instant HD video loop preview streaming from public CDN (https://storage.getlayers.ai/).
- Multi-viewport device testing: Desktop (16:9), Tablet (4:3), Mobile (9:16).
- Structured prompt export containing technical architecture, visual styling, sensory tone, animation guidelines, and responsive behavior rules.

## Technical Integration Guide

### Copy-Paste Component Installation
1. Copy the TSX code directly from the Component Modal.
2. Ensure Tailwind CSS is configured in your project.
3. Install standard animation dependencies if required:
   `npm install framer-motion lucide-react`
4. Paste the component into your project with zero custom configuration.
